description: Unit test class for the ImmutableConnection class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. The file contains test cases for creating, parsing, and validating ImmutableConnection instances, as well as verifying JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and URI parsing.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableConnection, testing its creation, JSON conversion, immutability, and URI parsing.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the ImmutableConnection class properly implements equals and hashCode.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutableConnection instances are immutable.

methods.name: createMinimalConnectionConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Tests creating a minimal connection instance with essential fields.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullId
methods.description: Tests that creating a connection with null ID throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullUri
methods.description: Tests that creating a connection with null URI throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: getBuilderFromConnectionCoversAllFields
methods.description: Verifies that the builder constructed from an existing connection populates all fields correctly.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullSources
methods.description: Tests that setting null sources throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullEventTarget
methods.description: Tests that setting null targets throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithoutSourceAndEventTarget
methods.description: Tests that building a connection without sources or targets throws a ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests JSON deserialization producing the expected ImmutableConnection object.

methods.name: fromJsonWithLegacyMappingContextReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies JSON deserialization handling legacy mapping contexts.

methods.name: fromInvalidJsonFails
methods.description: Ensures deserialization fails when JSON is missing required fields.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: emptyCertificatesLeadToEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that empty trusted certificates string results in an empty optional.

methods.name: emptyCertificatesFromJsonLeadToEmptyOptional
methods.description: Checks that JSON with empty trusted certificates leads to empty optional.

methods.name: parseUriAsExpected
methods.description: Tests URI parsing for a full URI string.

methods.name: parseUriWithoutCredentials
methods.description: Tests URI parsing when credentials are absent.

methods.name: parseUriWithoutPath
methods.description: Checks URI parsing for URI without a path component.

methods.name: cannotParseUriWithoutPort
methods.description: Ensures that URI parsing fails when port is missing.

methods.name: cannotParseUriWithoutHost
methods.description: Ensures parsing fails when hostname is missing.

methods.name: canParseUriWithUsernameWithoutPassword
methods.description: Verifies parsing of URI with username but empty password.

methods.name: canParseUriWithoutUsernameWithPassword
methods.description: Verifies parsing of URI with password but empty username.

methods.name: uriRegexFailsWithoutProtocol
methods.description: Ensures invalid URI strings without protocol fail parsing.

methods.name: toStringDoesNotContainPassword
methods.description: Verifies that the URI string representation does not include the password.
